Designed to work well with your own Claude "},{"id":"p1s3","text":"subscriptions and any harness with ACP support."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# AgentRQ ── Agent-Human Collaboration Platform"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"AgentRQ is a modern, high-performance platform designed for seamless collaboration between human ope"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"rators and AI agents. It leverages the **Model Context Protocol (MCP)** to allow AI models (like Cla"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"ude) to interact directly with your workspace's task management system."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## 🚀 Overview"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Think of AgentRQ as a shared workspace where humans and AI agents work together seamlessly. You can "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"break down complex goals into manageable tasks, and delegate work directly to your AI agents."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Because agents "see" the workspace state via MCP, they can autonomously pull their assigned tasks, u"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"pdate statuses, request permissions for sensitive actions, and communicate with you—all synchronized"},{"id":"p7s3","text":" instantly across the platform in real-time."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## ✨ Features"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Animated sketches of the main features."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"### Visual Task Board"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Every task Claude creates appears instantly on your board. See what it's working on, what it needs, "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"and what it just finished — all from a clean, fast dashboard you can open on any device, as a list o"},{"id":"p11s3","text":" just finished — all from a clean, fast dashboard you can open on any device, as a list or a Kanban."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### Task Scheduling"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Give any task a launch date, or a recurring cadence — every 15 minutes, hourly, daily, weekly, custo"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"m days. A background poller ticks every minute and spawns the task the instant it's due, no server o"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"r agent needing to stay awake and wait."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### Events"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Events are named signals — `qa_passed`, `deploy_finished`, `blog_published` — that any task can fire"},{"id":"p15s2","text":" when it completes. Wire one to a workspace and that workspace gets a new task automatically, no pol"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"ling and no glue code."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### Workflows"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"A Workflow is Events and workspaces arranged on a graph. Drag a workspace onto an event to subscribe"},{"id":"p17s2","text":" it; drag an event onto a workspace to emit it on completion. No decision-tree DSL, no YAML — just t"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"he shape of your release process, visible."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### Tool Call History"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"The task detail view's History tab lays out a lane-grouped timeline of every tool call and message i"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"n a run — Input, Agent, and Tools. Search it, click into any entry, and see exactly what ran, what i"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"t returned, and whether it was allowed or denied."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### YOLO Mode"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Flip **YOLO** on a task and every permission request its agent sends from then on is allowed automat"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"ically: no waiting on you, and each call is still recorded in the task's history as auto-allowed. Tu"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"rn it off and approvals come back. A workspace can turn it on for every task its agent creates, and "},{"id":"p21s4","text":"an event trigger or a workflow step can create its tasks with it on."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"### Task Timeline"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Under every task, a timeline shows each status it has been in and for how long: a dot per change, wi"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"th the time spent on the line to the next, stretches waiting on you in yellow and blocked ones in re"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"d. Above it, the totals say which agent worked on it and for how long, how long it was blocked or wa"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"ited for your input, and how long it took from start to close. Every status change is recorded with "},{"id":"p23s5","text":"the task itself, so nothing moves without leaving a dot."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"### Speech-to-Text"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Click the mic on any task description or reply and dictate it instead. Transcription runs on an in-b"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"rowser Whisper model — your voice is processed on-device and never uploaded anywhere."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"### Message Send Delay"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Give a workspace a countdown — 3s, 5s, 10s, 15s, 30s or 60s — and every chat message waits that long"},{"id":"p27s2","text":" in the thread before it reaches the agent. **Send Now** delivers it early, **Cancel** pulls it back"},{"id":"p27s3","text":" unsent and puts the exact text and attachments back in your composer. Off by default, per workspace."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"### Search & Keyboard Shortcuts"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"⌘K (Ctrl+K off macOS) opens a task finder that matches any word in a title or description, straight "},{"id":"p29s2","text":"from the copy your device already saved — so it answers offline, and tells you how far it looked. Ev"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"erything else is a bare letter: N for a new task, W and M to jump to a workspace or a machine, P for"},{"id":"p29s4","text":" the Pano, C and T to flip between a task's chat and its trajectory, ? for the list. Nothing to conf"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"igure, and nothing to memorise."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"### Machines"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"Install `agentrqd` on a computer you own, enrol it once with a single-use code typed on the machine "},{"id":"p31s2","text":"itself, and it becomes somewhere agents can run — in your repositories, with your toolchain. Pick a "},{"id":"p31s3","text":"workspace and what to run, and it starts in that workspace's folder on that machine. Each machine's "},{"id":"p31s4","text":"page shows what it has left: CPU, memory, uptime, load and free space per filesystem."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"### Live Terminals"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"Open a running session from any browser and you are at the prompt. Keystrokes go straight through as"},{"id":"p33s2","text":" the bytes your keys produced — Esc and Ctrl-C included — resizing reflows the program on the far en"},{"id":"p33s3","text":"d, and the session keeps running whether or not anybody is watching. Drop the network and the screen"},{"id":"p33s4","text":" is still there when you come back."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"### Skills"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"## 🏛 Architecture"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"AgentRQ follows a decoupled service-oriented architecture:"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"### Prerequisites

- **Node.js** 18+ (with npm)

- **Google Cloud Console**: An OAuth2 Client ID and Secret."},{"id":"p39s1","text":"### Why use the Supervisor?
- **Multi-Workspace Management**: List, create, and update workspaces.
-"},{"id":"p39s2","text":" **Global Task View**: Fetch tasks from all workspaces in a single call (`task.listAll`).
- **Admini"},{"id":"p39s3","text":"strative Control**: Manage task assignments, status, and priorities globally.
- **Unified Statistics"},{"id":"p39s4","text":"**: Access detailed statistics and health metrics for any workspace."}],"truncated":true}
